tool: supabase execute_sql (single transaction ending in rollback)
build: supabase/tests/build_assurance_candidate.ps1 -Slice A5 (A1, A2, A4, A4b, A3, A5 DDL+tests in install order); executed text is the exact build output, including the fail-on-any-failure diagnostic block
builderNote: The builder gained the A5 slice; its earlier slice outputs are byte-identical to the recorded A1-A3 builds.
syntheticSourceData: one additional synthetic engagement whose request due dates and finding issue time are back-dated inside the transaction to produce overdue and escalated items
covers: A5 adds no tables; read models authenticated-only; work-item helper not client-callable
reminder bands: on track, due soon (within 3 days), overdue (1-7 days late), escalated (more than 7 days late)
owner work queue lists own open requests and findings by due date with levels; unanswered findings fall due 14 days after issue
counts of due-soon, overdue and escalated work; archived engagements leave the queue
leads and auditors see overdue and escalated team items only; reviewers are not escalation targets
engagement register summarises open and overdue work, pages by id and is branch-scoped
external reviewers and other tenants are refused; a response moves the finding to its remediation due date; reads add no events
notCovered: no reminder or escalation is delivered (no notification, e-mail or scheduler); levels are computed when read
the response SLA (14 days) and reminder bands are fixed defaults
only the finding-owner response is a desktop write; other assurance commands remain API-only
doesNotEstablish: authenticated native Windows use of the workspace
accessibility review beyond automated 200% light/dark renders
